Public health guidelines explicitly advise against sharing such items during infestations to prevent spreading lice. This action is medically unsafe and irresponsible. Proper steps include treating the infestation, thoroughly cleaning or replacing the brush, and avoiding shared use until cleared by a healthcare provider.
